task.title: Setting-Up the FM Transmitter in Your Car
task.shortdesc: To begin using the device, you need to set it up to your car's radio station.

context.p: Setting up the device includes plugging the device into your car and channeling an unused radio frequency.

step.cmd: Tune the car radio to an unused FM radio frequency.image of car radio on an unused FM frequency.
Plug in the device into your car's cigarette lighter or power port.transmitter plugged into car's power port.
Locate and Press the CH Channel Button image of device locating CH Channel Button
Toggle the Multi-Function Button left/right to match the device's radio frequency to the pre-selected frequency on your car radio.image of matching frequency of car radio and transmitter

result.p: The car radio is succesfully connected to the device if there is no static or interference.
